name: Tremendos Libros
description: Uruguayan online bookstore of curated used books, including classics, rare titles, literature, philosophy and history. Based in San Carlos, Maldonado; ships across Uruguay through Correo Uruguayo and DAC.
description_es: Librería en línea uruguaya de libros usados seleccionados: clásicos, títulos raros, literatura, filosofía e historia. Con sede en San Carlos, Maldonado; envía a todo Uruguay por Correo Uruguayo y DAC.

ships_to.notes: FAQ states shipping to all of Uruguay by Correo Uruguayo and DAC, free from a stated minimum

fulfillment.pickup_notes: FAQ offers pickup at the San Carlos, Maldonado address, weekdays afternoon, coordinated by WhatsApp

shopping_notes: Used and rare books; shipping and pickup details in /preguntas-frecuentes.

sources.supports: used books catalog, free shipping threshold
carriers, shipping to all Uruguay, pickup in San Carlos
